$comment: 21 road connections over the 14 depots, following the real motorway/trunk-road skeleton (M1/M6/M62/M25/M4/A1 etc). distance is in drive points, not literal miles — scaled roughly 1 point per 12 real road miles so a 2d6 roll (average 7) covers a short hop in one turn and a long haul in two or three, the same pacing The Tea Race tunes its sail points to. weatherRisk (1-3, absent = clear) marks routes genuinely prone to fog, snow or flooding — the Pennine crossings and the Somerset Levels. theft (1-2, absent = safe) marks a handful of known freight-crime corridors, the road equivalent of The Tea Race's authored piracy rating.
